title: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-hoc image explanations usually show where a model looks using spatial heatmaps or indicate which channels matter using global channel scores. These separate views are limiting for multispectral data because channel relevance is often spatially localized and physically meaningful. We introduce Spectral-Spatial Interpretation (SSI), a full-grid attribution method over position-channel players (g,c). For each spatial position, SSI fixes the observed surrounding context, defines a conditional game over the channels at that position, and applies the Shapley value to this local game. The result is a full spectral-spatial attribution matrix rather than a single heatmap or a global channel ranking. SSI has a clear local interpretation. It satisfies Shapley fairness within each position, and aggregating its channel attributions exactly recovers the position-level contextual contrast obtained by replacing that position with the baseline. SSI

translated_abstract: 事后图像解释通常使用空间热力图来显示模型关注的区域，或使用全局通道分数来指示哪些通道重要。这两种分离的视角对于多光谱数据具有局限性，因为通道相关性往往是空间局部化的且具有物理意义。我们提出了光谱-空间解释，这是一种针对位置-通道参与者 (g,c) 的全网格归因方法。对于每个空间位置，SSI 固定已观测到的周围上下文，在该位置的通道上定义一个条件博弈，并将 Shapley 值应用于这一局部博弈。其结果是一个完整的光谱-空间归因矩阵，而不是单一的热力图或全局通道排序。SSI 具有清晰的局部解释性：它在每个位置内部满足 Shapley 公平性，并且对其通道归因进行聚合后，恰好能够恢复将该位置替换为基线时所得的位置级上下文对比度。
tldr: 提出 SSI 方法，通过在每个空间位置对通道构建条件博弈并计算 Shapley 值，生成完整的光谱-空间归因矩阵，实现了满足 Shapley 公平性且具有清晰局部解释性的多光谱模型解释。
en_tdlr: SSI is a full-grid attribution method that applies Shapley values to conditional games over channels at each spatial position, producing a complete spectral-spatial attribution matrix that satisfies Shapley fairness and offers clear local interpretability for multispectral model explanations.
